scripts.title: Silent Bomb Control
scripts.script:
--!strict

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local BOMB_NAME: string = "BombMissile"
local TOGGLE_KEY: Enum.KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.X
local SPEED: number = 300
local SPRINT_MULT: number = 2.5
local TURN_SENS: number = 0.003
local PITCH_CLAMP: number = math.rad(85)

local INVERT_AD: boolean = true
local BOMB_PITCH_OFFSET: number = math.rad(90)

local tracked: BasePart? = nil
local bodyVelocity: BodyVelocity? = nil
local active: boolean = false
local yaw: number = 0
local pitch: number = 0
local heartbeatConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local mouseMoveConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local keys: { [Enum.KeyCode]: boolean } = {}

local function findBomb(): BasePart?
	local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild(BOMB_NAME, true)
	if not obj then return nil end
	if obj:IsA("BasePart") then return obj end
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		return obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	end
	return nil
end

local function ensureThrust(part: BasePart): BodyVelocity
	local existing = part:FindFirstChild("NoraPilot") :: BodyVelocity?
	if existing then return existing end
	local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.Name = "NoraPilot"
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	bv.P = 10000
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = part
	return bv
end

local function cleanup()
	if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
		bodyVelocity:Destroy()
	end
	bodyVelocity = nil
	tracked = nil
	active = false
	keys = {}
	if heartbeatConn then heartbeatConn:Disconnect() heartbeatConn = nil end
	if mouseMoveConn then mouseMoveConn:Disconnect() mouseMoveConn = nil end
	Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	if LocalPlayer.Character then
		local head = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
			Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or head
		end
	end
end

local function start()
	tracked = findBomb()
	if not tracked then
		print("бомбы нет")
		return
	end

	bodyVelocity = ensureThrust(tracked)
	active = true
	keys = {}

	local cf = tracked.CFrame
	yaw = math.atan2(-cf.LookVector.X, -cf.LookVector.Z)
	pitch = math.asin(cf.LookVector.Y)

	Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	print("пилот на " .. tracked.Name)

	heartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		if not active then return end
		if not tracked or not tracked.Parent then
			cleanup()
			return
		end
		if not bodyVelocity or not bodyVelocity.Parent then
			bodyVelocity = ensureThrust(tracked)
		end

		local rot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch, yaw, 0)
		local forward = -rot.LookVector
		local right = rot.RightVector
		local up = Vector3.yAxis

		local adSign: number = if INVERT_AD then -1 else 1

		local move = Vector3.zero
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.W] then move += forward end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.S] then move -= forward end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.D] then move += right * adSign end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.A] then move -= right * adSign end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.Space] then move += up end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] then move -= up end

		local spd = SPEED
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] then spd *= SPRINT_MULT end

		if move.Magnitude > 0 then
			move = move.Unit * spd
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = move

		local bombRot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch + BOMB_PITCH_OFFSET, yaw, 0)
		tracked.CFrame = CFrame.new(tracked.Position) * bombRot
		Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(tracked.Position - forward * 12 + up * 4, tracked.Position + forward * 10)
	end)

	mouseMoveConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if not active then return end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		if not UserInputService.MouseBehavior then return end
		yaw -= input.Delta.X * TURN_SENS
		pitch -= input.Delta.Y * TURN_SENS
		pitch = math.clamp(pitch, -PITCH_CLAMP, PITCH_CLAMP)
	end)

	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gpe: boolean)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == TOGGLE_KEY then
		if active then
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
			UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
			cleanup()
			print("вышел")
		else
			start()
		end
		return
	end
	if active then
		keys[input.KeyCode] = true
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
	keys[input.KeyCode] = false
end)

		if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		infJumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setNoclip(on)
		if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect(); noclipConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setFullbright(on)
		if on then
			if not savedLighting then
				savedLighting = {
					Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
					ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
					Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
					GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				}
			end
			Lighting.Brightness     = 3
			Lighting.ClockTime      = 14
			Lighting.Ambient        = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.FogEnd         = 1e6
			Lighting.GlobalShadows  = false
		elseif savedLighting then
			for k, v in pairs(savedLighting) do
				pcall(function() Lighting[k] = v end)
			end
			savedLighting = nil
		end
	end

	local function setFly(on)
		if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
		if flyBV   then flyBV:Destroy();      flyBV   = nil end
		if not on then return end
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = hum and hum.RootPart
		if not root then return end
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "HackingBrosFly"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		bv.Parent = root
		flyBV = bv
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not flyBV or not flyBV.Parent then return end
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			flyBV.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * 60 or Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	local function setSpeedBoost(on)
		speedBoostOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedSpeed == nil then savedSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed end
			hum.WalkSpeed = 100
		elseif savedSpeed ~= nil then
			hum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed
			savedSpeed = nil
		end
	end

	local function setJumpPower(on)
		jumpPowerOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedJumpPower == nil then
				savedJumpPower    = hum.JumpPower
				savedUseJumpPower = hum.UseJumpPower
			end
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		elseif savedJumpPower ~= nil then
			hum.JumpPower     = savedJumpPower
			hum.UseJumpPower  = savedUseJumpPower
			savedJumpPower    = nil
			savedUseJumpPower = nil
		end
	end

	local function resetCharacter()
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
	end

		pcall(function()

		if speedBoostOn then hum.WalkSpeed = 100 end
		if jumpPowerOn then

				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,

				stroke.Color = state and uc.On or uc.Border
				btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and uc.SurfaceHi or uc.Surface
			end

			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				state = not state
				render()
				local ok, err = pcall(callback, state)
				if not ok then
					warn("[HackingBros] " .. label .. ": " .. tostring(err))

					render()

		makeAction(8, "Rejoin Server",            rejoinServer)

		minBtn.Activated:Connect(function()

				content.Visible = false
				panel2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, 48)
				minBtn.Text = "+"
			else
				content.Visible = true
				panel2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, PANEL_H)
				minBtn.Text = "–"
			end
		end)

		close2.Activated:Connect(function()
			if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
			if noclipConn  then noclipConn:Disconnect();  noclipConn  = nil end
			if flyConn     then flyConn:Disconnect();     flyConn     = nil end
			if flyBV       then flyBV:Destroy();          flyBV       = nil end
			setFullbright(false)
			screen2:Destroy()
		end)

		-- -- drag
		local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
		header2.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging  = true
				dragInput = input
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos  = panel2.Position
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if dragging and (input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
				local delta = input.Position - dragStart
				panel2.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
					startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
				)
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input == dragInput then
				dragging  = false
				dragInput = nil
			end
		end)

		return screen2
	end

	-- =========================================================
	-- RUN
	-- =========================================================
	showSplash(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(buildUI)
		if not ok then
			warn("[HackingBros] failed to build UI: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end)
end

scripts.features:
🎮 Minigame Hub: 22 playable minigames in one draggable, mobile-friendly UI
## Hub features
- **Draggable** by the title bar, clamped to the screen
- **Minimise** to a small pill, **close** to destroy everything and clean up connections
- **Games pause** while the window is minimised
- **Mobile friendly:** scales to the screen, with tap, swipe and on-screen d-pad controls
- **Back button** and a scrollable game menu
- **Session best scores** for every game
- **Pure Luau and UI:** no models, images or sounds, and no server code

## Game list

### Arcade and reflex
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Tap Rush** | Tap as many times as you can in 10 seconds. Shows taps per second and your best. |
| 4 | **Snake** | 14×14 grid that speeds up as you eat. Controls: d-pad, swipe, arrow keys or WASD. |
| 6 | **Reaction Test** | Tap when the screen turns green. Tapping early fails the round. Scored in milliseconds. |
| 7 | **Whack-a-Mole** | 3×3 holes over 20 seconds. Moles appear faster and vanish sooner as time runs down. |
| 10 | **Flappy Block** | Tap or press Space to flap through pipes. Gravity and collisions run on Heartbeat. |

### Memory and puzzle
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | **Memory Match** | 4×4 card flip with 8 pairs. Fewer moves is a better score. |
| 8 | **Simon Says** | Repeat a growing colour sequence. |
| 14 | **Lights Out** | 5×5 puzzle where tapping a light toggles its neighbours. Puzzles are always solvable. |
| 17 | **2048** | Swipe, d-pad or keys. Tiles merge once per move, and you can keep playing past 2048. |
| 18 | **Minesweeper** | 9×9 with 8, 12 or 16 mines. Dig/Flag toggle, first tap always safe, chording, and a timer. |
| 20 | **Sudoku** | Every puzzle has exactly one solution. Easy, Medium and Hard (40, 33 and 27 clues), with hints, reset, timer and highlighting. |

### Quick-think and word
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | **Number Guess** | Guess 1–100 in 8 tries, with a narrowing range hint. |
| 11 | **Math Dash** | 30 seconds of add, subtract and multiply. A wrong answer costs 2 seconds. |
| 12 | **Higher or Lower** | Card streak game. Equal cards are a push. |
| 13 | **Color Clash** | Stroop test where you tap the ink colour, not the word. 25 seconds, and a wrong answer costs 2 seconds. |
| 21 | **Hangman** | 4 categories with 14 words each, a drawn gallows and a keyboard. Has two rare boss words (see below). |

### Versus AI
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | **Tic Tac Toe** | Minimax AI that makes the occasional mistake so it can be beaten. The starting player alternates. |
| 9 | **RPS Battle** | Rock, paper, scissors with a win/loss/draw tally. |
| 15 | **UNO** | Full 108-card deck, wild colour picker, UNO call and catch rules. Choose a **Bot IQ** (see below). |
| 16 | **Connect 4** | Minimax with alpha-beta pruning at 3 difficulties. |
| 19 | **Checkers** | American rules: forced captures, multi-jumps, kings. Minimax AI at 3 depths, with a 50-move draw rule. |
| 22 | **Battleship** | 8×8 board and a fleet of 5, 4, 3, 3 and 2. Shuffle your ships, 3 bot levels. |

## AI details

**UNO Bot IQ**
- **Easy:** random legal plays and random colour picks. It sometimes forgets to call UNO, and you can catch it.
- **Medium:** saves wilds, prefers action cards, keeps its longest colour.
- **Hard:** counts unseen cards, remembers which colours you couldn't answer, and saves +4 for when you're close to winning.
